name: KEYSTONE_DB_PASSWORD
description: The password of the bundled Postgres. Used by compose to build the database URL.

name: KEYSTONE_TOKEN_PEPPER
description: A secret mixed into every API key and session digest. Changing it signs everyone out and invalidates every API key.

name: KEYSTONE_LOCAL_AUTH_SECRET
description: Signs the built-in sign-in tokens. Changing it signs everyone out.

name: KEYSTONE_SETUP_TOKEN
description: The one-time key that lets you create the owner account at /setup. Unused after setup.

name: KEYSTONE_MASTER_KEY
description: Wraps the keys that seal stored secrets (webhook secrets, SMTP passwords, two-step secrets) and each workspace's key for its stored document files. Back it up with the database: without it sealed secrets and the stored files cannot be opened.

name: DOCUSTAY_REFUSE_PLAINTEXT_FILES
description: Set to on once `scripts/file-keys.mjs status` shows every workspace as all files sealed: a stored file that is not sealed is then refused instead of served. Leave it off until then; files stored before encryption existed are served as they are until the worker's sealing pass has been through them.

name: KEYSTONE_PUBLIC_URL
description: The address people open Docustay at, without a path. Every signing link, reset link and email starts with it.

name: KEYSTONE_DOCUSTAY_APP_URL
description: The address of the signed-in app, when it differs from the signing address.

name: KEYSTONE_DOCUSTAY_SIGN_URL
description: The address signing links start with.

name: DOCUSTAY_PORT
description: The port on this machine the web app listens on.

name: PORT
description: The port the API process listens on inside its container.

name: KEYSTONE_TRUSTED_PROXY_HOPS
description: How many reverse proxies sit in front. With 0 every visitor looks like the proxy and shares one rate limit; set 1 behind one proxy.

name: KEYSTONE_DB_SUPERUSER_URL
description: Connection string the migration runner uses. It creates the application roles on first run.

name: KEYSTONE_DATABASE_URL
description: Connection string for the application role, when you run the database yourself.

name: KEYSTONE_DB_SSL
description: Set to off for a database in the same private network without TLS (the bundled compose does).

name: KEYSTONE_PG_POOL_MAX
description: Largest number of database connections the API keeps.

name: KEYSTONE_S3_ENDPOINT
description: Address of the S3-compatible store that keeps signed PDFs.

name: KEYSTONE_S3_BUCKET
description: The bucket (created for you by the bundled store).

name: KEYSTONE_S3_ACCESS_KEY_ID
description: Access key for the file store.

name: KEYSTONE_S3_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
description: Secret key for the file store.

name: KEYSTONE_S3_REGION
description: Region name some S3 providers require.

name: KEYSTONE_GOTENBERG_URL
description: Address of the PDF converter (Gotenberg) that prints documents.

name: RESEND_API_KEY
description: Your own Resend API key. Leave empty to use your own SMTP server (Settings → Email).

name: KEYSTONE_MAIL_SENDER
description: The From address used until you verify your own domain.

name: KEYSTONE_MAIL_DAILY_LIMIT
description: Hard cap on emails sent per day by this install.

name: KEYSTONE_EMAIL_ALLOWLIST
description: Comma list of addresses/domains mail may go to. Everything else is dropped. Use it on a test install.

name: KEYSTONE_LOCAL_AUTH
description: Uses the built-in sign-in (email and password). Firebase is for the hosted service only.

name: KEYSTONE_PASSKEYS
description: Set to 1 to let people sign in with passkeys. Needs KEYSTONE_PASSKEY_ORIGINS.

name: KEYSTONE_PASSKEY_ORIGINS
description: Comma list of web addresses a passkey may be used from. A passkey is tied to the address's host name.

name: KEYSTONE_SIGNING_CERT_PEM
description: The certificate that seals finished documents. By default Docustay makes one for this install; set your own to use a certificate from a trusted authority.

name: KEYSTONE_SIGNING_CERT_PATH
description: Path to a PEM file instead of the value itself.

name: DOCUMENT_TSA_URL
description: A trusted timestamp authority; when set, finished documents carry a trusted timestamp.

name: KEYSTONE_METRICS_TOKEN
description: Turns on GET /metrics (Prometheus). Callers send Authorization: Bearer TOKEN, where TOKEN is this value. At least 16 characters.

name: KEYSTONE_LOG_REDACTION
description: Server and worker logs leave out email addresses and credentials. off turns that off (only for debugging a test install).

name: DOCUSTAY_TELEMETRY
description: off stops the one anonymous daily usage ping (a random install id, the version, five counts).

name: DOCUSTAY_LICENSE_KEY
description: A Pro licence key. With it the worker checks the licence daily and unlocks Pro features.

name: KEYSTONE_ENVIRONMENT
description: staging for a test install: live Stripe keys are refused and email goes only to the allowlist.

name: KEYSTONE_ALERT_EMAIL
description: Where the install sends operational alerts (a failing backup, a paused sender).

name: KEYSTONE_SELF_HOST
description: Marks this as a self-hosted install: hides hosted-only screens such as billing.

name: KEYSTONE_STRIPE_SECRET_KEY
description: Your own Stripe secret key for collecting payments at signing.

name: KEYSTONE_STRIPE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY
description: The matching publishable key. With it the signer pays inside the signing page as its last step; without it they pay on Stripe's own page and come back.

name: KEYSTONE_STRIPE_CHARGES_ENABLED
description: A safety switch: live charges stay refused until this is on.

name: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY
description: Your own Anthropic key. Without it the AI drafting, reviewing and chat features are hidden.

name: KEYSTONE_AI_DEFAULT_MODEL
description: The model used for drafting.

name: DOCUSTAY_OIDC_ISSUER
description: The address of your OpenID Connect provider (Keycloak, Authentik, Entra, Okta…), for example https://sso.example.com/realms/main. Setting this, the client id and the client secret turns on single sign-on.

name: DOCUSTAY_OIDC_CLIENT_ID
description: The client id you made for Docustay at your provider.

name: DOCUSTAY_OIDC_CLIENT_SECRET
description: The client secret for that client. Keep it as private as the other secrets in `.env`.

name: DOCUSTAY_OIDC_LABEL
description: The name on the sign-in button: “Sign in with …”.

name: DOCUSTAY_OIDC_SCOPES
description: What to ask the provider for. It must include `openid` and `email`.
